items.t: Transmission slips, drops into neutral or shifts hard
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service as a first step
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $242 to $293 for the service. If the clutches are worn, a rebuild costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: Intake manifold gaskets leak coolant
items.job: Replace intake manifold gaskets with updated metal-core gaskets
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $851 to $1,013 on 1996-2001 models.

items.t: Spider fuel injector leaks or misfires
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $627 to $861 on 1996-2001 models.

items.t: Misfire from a worn distributor cap and rotor
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $122 to $191.

items.t: AWD lights flash and AWD stops working
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $549 to $798 on 2002-2004 models. Wiring repairs cost less.

items.t: Cooling fan roars or engine runs hot
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $782 to $1,045 on 2002-2004 models.

items.t: Blower runs only on some speeds or quits
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $156 to $213 on 2002-2004 models.

items.t: Power window pops when going up
items.job: Apply anti-noise tape to regulator; replace regulator if it fails
items.note: The tape fix is cheap; a new regulator is about $264 to $407.

items.t: Rattle or clunk over bumps from stabilizer links

items.t: Rough idle or stalling from the idle control valve or throttle sensor
items.job: Clean throttle body and replace idle air control valve
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, since no parts-plus-labor source was found: $286-$392 for 1996-1999 4.3L trucks (average parts about $96). A worn throttle position sensor is a separate, similar-size repair.

items.t: AWD shudder or clunk in tight turns
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, since no parts-plus-labor source was found: about $141-$161 for 1997-2001, $162-$224 at shops. If the shudder stays after fresh fluid, transfer case repair costs much more.

items.t: Ignition switch failure: gauges die and transmission sticks in third
items.note: Based on YourMechanic, since no parts-plus-labor source was found: about $351 on 2002-2004 Bravadas, $397-$531 at shops and dealers.

items.t: Rear sits low from a failed air suspension compressor
items.job: Replace rear air compressor, or convert rear to coil springs
items.note: Low end is a Strutmasters rear coil-spring conversion kit ($189, about an hour per wheel); high end is a Dorman replacement compressor ($449). Replacing a leaking air spring instead runs about $1,340-$1,520 per side at YourMechanic.

items.t: Fuel vapor smell from a cracked tank inlet valve
items.job: Replace fuel tank (GM's fix for a leaking inlet check valve)
items.note: GM's special coverage bulletin lists 2.3 hours to inspect and replace the tank. The GM tank lists at about $670 (supply has been short); aftermarket tanks may cost less.
